name: Theme: Apply Design Tokens
description: Pushes a design_token impulse that applies CSS custom properties to the browser viewport. Sets the visual baseline — colors, fonts, spacing — that all subsequent render_ui calls inherit. Run once at session start or when switching themes.

tasks.description: Push design tokens to the browser via render_ui.

prompt.template:
Apply a design theme to the react-renderer browser viewport using render_ui.

Theme: {{theme}}
Custom tokens (JSON): {{tokens}}

Pick one of these named themes (or use 'custom' to apply the provided tokens directly):
- **default**: Clean white background, gray text, blue accents
- **dark**: Dark background (#0f172a), slate text, blue/purple accents
- **warm**: Warm off-white (#faf9f6), dark brown text, amber accents
- **technical**: Pure black background, green-on-dark terminal style
- **minimal**: Very light gray (#fafafa), minimal borders, generous whitespace

For the chosen theme, push a design_token primitive containing these CSS custom properties:
- --background (page background)
- --foreground (primary text)
- --card (card background)
- --card-foreground
- --primary (accent color)
- --primary-foreground
- --muted (muted background)
- --muted-foreground
- --border (border color)
- --radius (border radius, e.g. 0.5rem)
- --font-sans (font stack)

If theme is 'custom' and custom tokens are provided, use those tokens directly.

Call render_ui ONCE with:
- primitive.type: design_token
- primitive.content: the token map (CSS custom property names starting with --)
- animation: none (tokens apply instantly)
- position.mode: flow

The design_token primitive renders nothing visible — it only applies CSS variables to :root.

variables.name: theme
variables.description: Named theme: default, dark, warm, technical, minimal. Defaults to default.

variables.name: tokens
variables.description: Custom CSS tokens as JSON object, e.g. {"--background": "#fff", "--primary": "#2563eb"}. Only used when theme is 'custom'.
